criteria.evidence: Opens with "Switching embedding models is often not the fix" and says to check where the failure is first; it only lists candidate models conditionally, after diagnosis.
criteria.criterion: Do not immediately replace the embedding model.

criteria.evidence: Covers retrieval (was the right chunk in top-k, chunking, reranker, hybrid), context construction (too few/many chunks passed, metadata/filters), and generation (prompt, 'answer only from context'). It distinguishes retrieval vs. generation failures.
criteria.criterion: Trace retrieval, context construction, and generation.

criteria.evidence: Prescribes taking 20-30 bad answers and checking each, then building a 50-100 question labeled eval set measuring recall@k and MRR before deciding; asks for example failures.
